data.label: Cell
data.note: The skewed square the position is in, and where in it.

data.label: Fast
data.note:
The 3 corners of the triangle the position is in: the square's
two ends of its diagonal, and the corner on the position's side.

data.label: Smooth
data.note:
The square's diagonal ends, and the 2 points across the triangle's
other edges that its larger kernels reach, past the square when
the position is near a corner.
